_readme: Copy to device.local.json (git-ignored) and add one row per run on the iPhone (DEVICE_TEST_PLAN S1-17, protocol in F05 section 9: unplugged, room temperature, 2-minute cool-down). finishToTextSeconds: from tapping Finish to the words on Review. audioSeconds: the letter's length (the speed bar uses the 2-minute ones, 110 to 130 s). jetsam: true if the app was killed while writing the words down. Then: npm run gate -w @scribe/experiments -- --language en --device experiments/device.local.json
